item.text: The source supports the seed’s overall structure, with two details to qualify: large runs clear prior compiler reuse but can retain a newly created semantic program until release, and the derived universe excludes specific entity kinds, not every entity with a structural identity. I’ll make the peripheral trees cover compiler lifetime, incremental reuse, derivation, and output validation.

Four peripheral trees expand compiler lifetime, incremental reuse, derivation, and persistence, attached to their corresponding concept lines. Modular structure combines boundaries, visibility and dependencies conceptually; the stored schema still separates containment and lexical views. Data dependency remains the graph of computational requirements.

Source-grounded corrections: context.ts clears previousProgram before runs selecting more than 100 paths, but first checker access can assign a new semantic program; releaseCompiler clears that shared reference when it matches the large run's active program. Thus the seed's claim that large runs disable retention throughout the run was too broad. derive.ts excludes an explicit list of entity kinds, not all structurally identified entities; the universe description now preserves this distinction.

Peripheral details absent from the seed include BOM-preserving compiler reads and identity collisions (context.ts), metric settings being absent from fragment keys and Node16/NodeNext fallback (incremental.ts), iterative Kosaraju and directory comparison selection (derive.ts), and canonical propertyPath ordering plus separate stream verification (persistence.ts). Per-file publication, rather than a transaction across all three outputs, follows from the sequential renames in scripts/analysis/analyze.ts.

Evidence is limited to the supplied point definition and eight pinned source texts. Imported extractor, metric, finding, report and incremental-helper implementations were not supplied; their internal behavior is not inferred beyond visible calls and contracts. Static call evidence does not establish runtime activation history, and no browser generation stage is established. The layout uses measured text bounds: 12 blank columns between the central tree and peripherals, and five blank rows between peripheral trees.",
